# Erdos.p982 — Erdős problem 982

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/982
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/982.lean`, theorem `erdos_982`, AMS 52).

If $n$ distinct points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ form a convex polygon then some vertex has at least
$\lfloor\frac{n}{2}\rfloor$ different distances to other vertices.

## Statement
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (p : Fin n → ℝ²) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (hp' : EuclideanGeometry.IsConvexPolygon p), ∃ (i : Fin n), { d : ℝ | ∃ j : Fin n, j ≠ i ∧ d = dist (p i) (p j) }.ncard ≥ n / 2

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
